Cách đơn giản để tận hưởng mọi chuyến đi

Trải nghiệm sự tự do đến từ sự độc lập hoàn toàn. Dù ở lứa tuổi nào, Vasco Translator M4 cũng giúp bạn hiểu rõ hơn về con người và thế giới xung quanh, để bạn tận hưởng trọn vẹn từng chuyến đi. Đây là công nghệ thân thiện thiết kế giúp cuộc sống dễ dàng hơn: siêu nhẹ, cực kỳ trực quan, trang bị loa công suất lớn và micro chống ồn. Với các tính năng dịch giọng nói, văn bản và hình ảnh, bạn có thể khám phá những điểm đến mới, bắt đầu những cuộc trò chuyện ý nghĩa mà không gặp rào cản. Và đặc biệt hơn, thiết bị dịch thuật này sẵn sàng sử dụng ngay khi mở hộp.

Công nghệ hiện đại bạn sẽ yêu thích ngay từ ngày đầu

Bắt đầu sử dụng ngay khi mở hộp

Thiết bị phiên dịch cầm tay này không cần cài đặt hay tìm kiếm thiết lập phức tạp. Bạn có thể sử dụng ngay thời điểm bước xuống máy bay. Với Internet miễn phí không giới hạn tại gần 200 quốc gia, bạn không cần tìm kiếm Wi-Fi hay mua SIM nội địa. Và khi trở về nhà, sẽ không có khoản cước bất ngờ nào—data của bạn được miễn phí trọn đời! Chế độ tự động thậm chí còn tự nhận diện ngôn ngữ để cuộc trò chuyện diễn ra tự nhiên.

One button to understand the whole world

The passion for travel has no expiry date—especially with the Vasco Translator M4 in your pocket. This compact language translator is the perfect companion for both young adventurers and mature travelers. Featuring powerful speakers and adjustable text size, it ensures you can hear and see every translation clearly. Physical buttons make it incredibly easy to use, and if you prefer a touchscreen, it’s been refined to perfection too.

One translator, endless possibilities

Dịch giọng nói

Communicate in over 85 languages with ease. This pocket translator converts your words into your conversation partner’s language—and vice versa. Ask for the best pastry in a Parisian café, book tickets at a museum in Rome, or enjoy a fascinating conversation in a Spanish palm grove. With 99% translation accuracy, you can rest assured that language barriers won't spoil your trip or lead to awkward misunderstandings. The automatic mode detects the language for you, allowing for free-flowing conversation without having to tap the microphone button.

Dịch hình ảnh

Feel confident wherever you go. Take a photo of a menu, timetable, hotel leaflet, or museum sign, and translate it into your language in seconds. With just one click, even foreign alphabets are no longer a mystery. You can zoom in on the photo and display the text on a white background for even better readability.

Dịch văn bản

A handy feature for checking pronunciation or translating specific phrases. All your typed phrases are saved in your history, which you can easily send to other devices.

Ứng dụng học ngôn ngữ

How do you say "thank you" in Portuguese? Sometimes, just one word in the local language can bring a wide smile to someone's face and show your respect for their culture. It’s a small gesture that can turn a simple chat into a special moment. With the language learning app on the Vasco Translator M4, you can master new words and phrases—it’s also a great way to pass the time while you travel.

Internet miễn phí trọn đời tại gần 200 quốc gia. Forever.

Forget about searching for a connection while traveling. As the only company on the market, we offer free, unlimited internet—forever and with Không phí thuê bao. Thanks to the built-in SIM card in your pocket translator, there’s no need to look for Wi-Fi or deal with foreign mobile operators. Most importantly, you can say goodbye to roaming charges and unexpected bills. Enjoy unlimited data for translations, wherever your journey takes you.

When are Vasco Translators most useful?

Travel

Take the Vasco Translator M4 with you and make the most of every trip. Forget about language barriers and enjoy independence with this instant language translation tool, ensuring effortless communication wherever you go.

When you travel with Vasco Translator M4:

  • Booking tickets and making reservations becomes quick and easy
  • Technology truly supports you instead of causing frustration
  • You feel confident in any situation
  • You can have meaningful conversations with people from around the world
  • You explore independently and on your own terms

As a gift

Do you know someone with an appetite for life but whose travel dreams are held back by language barriers? Instead of exploring the world, they can only watch it on TV. Vasco Translator M4 pocket translator makes communication abroad simple and travel safer. It’s a gift that gives your loved ones the freedom to explore—and gives you peace of mind knowing they’ll manage just fine.

When you give Vasco Translator M4 as a gift:

  • You give them the opportunity to discover the world—and relive their second youth!
  • You know they’ll feel confident communicating while travelling
  • You’re sure they’ll manage in hotels, restaurants, or at the airport
  • No subscriptions or hidden fees—just a one-time purchase with free unlimited internet included
  • You’re giving a premium gift that will bring countless smiles
  • You care about their safety—Vasco is a European company operating in line with global data protection standards
  • They receive technical support in their native language
  • No need to install apps or configure a smartphone
  • You don’t have to worry about helping them use the device

Life abroad

Vasco Translator M4 is an essential language translation tool for whenever a foreign country becomes your home. Whether you’re working abroad or enjoying retirement in a warmer climate, it helps you feel confident and secure in your new surroundings.

With Vasco Translator M4 abroad:

  • You can easily communicate with employers, colleagues, and neighbours
  • You’re confident handling matters at offices, banks, or medical appointments
  • You manage everyday tasks independently—from shopping to repairs or visiting a hairdresser
  • You feel at home, as language barriers no longer limit your daily life

Khám phá thêm features of the Vasco Translator M4

Điều chỉnh tốc độ phát

Customize the speech rate to suit your needs. Slow down the playback on your pocket translator to catch every nuance or speed it up when you're in a hurry.

Bộ lọc từ ngữ không phù hợp

This feature detects and censors offensive language in both text and voice translations. Perfect for moments when diplomacy matters—it preserves the meaning while avoiding awkward situations.

Screen zoom

Enlarge text or photos to see your translation clearly. No more squinting—unless it’s from the blazing sun on the beach!

Loa công suất lớn and a noise-cancelling microphones

The Vasco language translation tool features a precise microphones and powerful speakers. The microphones reduces background noise by up to 99%, and the speakers deliver crystal-clear sound, so you can communicate easily on a busy street, at a crowded market, or in a noisy bar.

Full-screen mode

Need a closer look? No need to reach for your glasses—just rotate your device to switch to full-screen mode.

Chia sẻ bản dịch

With Vasco, you won’t miss a thing. You can always return to saved translations or share them—for example, via email.

Cập nhật phần mềm liên tục

Vasco Translator M4 is built to last for years. Not only is it durable, but it also receives regular updates—so you can enjoy the latest software improvements long after your purchase.

Sẵn sàng sử dụng

Vasco Translator M4 is an instant language translator that’s ready to use straight out of the box. Just turn it on. There are no complicated setups or settings to navigate. When you’re traveling, simply pull it out of your pocket and start talking.

Chất lượng tiêu chuẩn Châu Âu

Vasco is a brand with nearly twenty years of experience. All our devices are designed by our expert engineering team, ensuring top-tier quality. This guarantees data security and a high-performance product that will serve you for many years to come.

Vasco Translator M4 is a true travel companion, designed for real-life use on the go. The device is shock-resistant and splash-proof, so you don’t have to worry when using it by the pool or during a trip to the mountains.

We’re always by your side. You can count on us before, during, and after your purchase. If you have any questions, our specialists are ready to help—in your language.

Sử dụng dễ dàng & Thuận tiện

FAQ

What is a pocket translator, and how does Vasco Translator M4 work?

Handheld language translator Vasco Translator M4 is a simple, ready-to-use device that translates speech, text, and photos instantly. It works out of the box with strong speakers and an easy-to-press button.

Is Vasco Translator M4 a reliable language translation tool for travel?

YES. Language translation device provides fast and accurate translations in real time, helping you communicate easily while traveling.

Can a compact language translator like Vasco Translator M4 replace mobile apps?

YES. A portable translator device works independently, without the need for a smartphone or additional apps.

Is this small translator suitable for everyday communication abroad?

YES. With over 85 spoken languages and instant translation, this portable translator device is perfect for everyday conversations while traveling.

Does a compact translator work without a complicated setup?

YES. Handheld translator Vasco Translator M4 is ready to use immediately after turning it on.

Can this handy translator be used without a smartphone?

YES. A small language translator works fully independently, with no need for a phone or external apps.

What makes Vasco Translator M4 a good handheld translator device for travelers?

Mini translator’s fast translation, robust build, unlimited internet tại gần 200 quốc gia, and simple operation make it ideal for travel.

Is Vasco Translator M4 a pocket translator device with real-time translation?
